name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefitSummary: ₹6,000 per year in three equal ₹2,000 installments directly to eligible farmer bank accounts.
documents: Aadhaar card linked to active bank account
Land ownership / patta / chitta / adangal records
Bank passbook copy and mobile number
applySteps: Visit the PM-KISAN portal or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP or biometric authentication.
Submit landholding details and bank account linkage for state verification.

rules.reason: Member is registered/active as a farmer
Cultivable landholding is within eligible limits
Household income is in lower income bracket

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
benefitSummary: Monthly social security pension for eligible widows from low-income households (central + state top-up where applicable).
documents: Income certificate / BPL or low-income proof
applySteps: Collect death certificate, income proof, and bank details.
Submit application at the taluk/block social welfare office or state e-governance portal.
Track verification and direct benefit transfer (DBT) disbursement.

rules.reason: Household annual income is below ₹1 lakh

name: Pre/Post-Matric Scholarship for Class 9–12 Students
benefitSummary: Annual financial assistance covering tuition/books/maintenance allowance for students in Classes 9 to 12.
documents: Current school bonafide / enrollment proof for Class 9–12
Previous class mark sheet or promotion record
Aadhaar card and student/linked bank account details
applySteps: Log in to the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or state scholarship portal.
Select the Class 9–12 scholarship scheme and enter academic & income details.
Get institution verification completed by the school.

rules.reason: Household income qualifies for student scholarship

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
benefitSummary: Monthly pension support for senior citizens (60+ years) in low-income households.
documents: Age proof showing 60 years or above
applySteps: Apply via block/municipal welfare desk or online NSAP/state portal.
Complete age and income verification.
Receive monthly pension directly in bank account.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Health Cover
benefitSummary: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
documents: Ration card or family identity proof
applySteps: Check family eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or Ayushman app.
Complete e-KYC at a CSC or empaneled hospital kiosk.
Download Ayushman card for cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals.

rules.reason: Household falls within low-income eligibility bracket

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
benefitSummary: Financial assistance to build a pucca house with basic amenities for eligible rural families.
documents: Aadhaar card and job card / consent form
applySteps: Confirm inclusion in the rural housing survey / priority list at the panchayat.
Complete geo-tagging and bank account seeding.
Receive stage-wise construction installments.

rules.reason: Low-income household eligible for rural housing support

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefitSummary: Crop insurance against non-preventable natural risks at a low subsidized farmer premium.
documents: Notified crop details for the season
applySteps: Select notified crop and season on the PMFBY portal, CSC, or bank branch.
Pay the low farmer premium share before the cutoff date.
Report crop loss within 72 hours if damage occurs.

rules.reason: Member is a farmer cultivating crops
Household income is within eligible range

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Working Capital Support
benefitSummary: Short-term credit line for seeds, fertilizers, and farm operations at concessional interest rates.
applySteps: Apply at your bank branch or via PM-KISAN KCC camp.
Submit land/cultivation records and ID documents.
Receive KCC limit upon bank sanction.

name: PM SVANidhi Micro Working Capital Support
benefitSummary: Collateral-free working capital loans with interest subsidy and digital transaction cashback for small vendors.
documents: Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation where applicable
applySteps: Apply online or via urban local body / CSC.
Complete KYC and vendor verification.
Receive loan tranche disbursement.

name: NFSA Priority Household Foodgrain Entitlement
benefitSummary: Monthly subsidized/entitled foodgrains for priority households under the National Food Security Act.
applySteps: Verify priority household status on the state food/ration portal.
Complete Aadhaar authentication at the Fair Price Shop (FPS).
Collect monthly entitlement.

name: Tamil Nadu Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam (Farmers Social Security)
benefitSummary: Social security, accident/disability relief, and family support for registered farmers and farm laborers.
applySteps: Register or verify details at the taluk/block agriculture or welfare office.
Submit bank and Aadhaar details.
Claim benefits as applicable under scheme guidelines.

rules.reason: Member is engaged in farming/agricultural work

name: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme (State Welfare)
benefitSummary: Monthly pension assistance for destitute widows meeting income and residency norms.
applySteps: Apply through taluk office or e-Sevai / citizen portal with required certificates.
Undergo revenue/welfare verification.
Receive monthly pension in bank account.

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance (Pudhumai Penn)
benefitSummary: Monthly ₹1,000 assistance for eligible female students pursuing higher education after school.
applySteps: Apply via the Pudhumai Penn portal or college nodal officer after enrolling in higher education.
Complete verification.
Receive monthly transfer upon meeting attendance norms.

name: PM Vishwakarma Craft & Skill Support
benefitSummary: Skill training, toolkit incentive, and credit support for traditional artisans and craft workers.
documents: Aadhaar card and active mobile number
applySteps: Register on the PM Vishwakarma portal or via CSC.
Complete 3-level verification and skill assessment.
Access toolkit voucher and credit facility.

name: MGNREGA Guaranteed Rural Wage Employment
benefitSummary: Demand-driven rural wage employment guarantee for adult household members willing to do unskilled manual work.
documents: Job card registration for the household
Aadhaar card and bank/post office account
applySteps: Ensure household has an active MGNREGA job card at the gram panchayat.
Submit written/logged demand for work.
Receive wages directly into bank/post office account.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
benefitSummary: Annual scholarship (₹12,000/year) for meritorious students from economically weaker sections in Classes 9 to 12.
documents: Class 8 qualifying exam / NMMSS selection record
applySteps: Qualify in the state NMMSS exam and apply on NSP.
Get school and state nodal verification.
Receive annual scholarship amount via DBT.

rules.reason: Household annual income is below ₹1 lakh

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefitSummary: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 starting at age 60 based on contribution and age at entry.
documents: Savings bank or post office account
applySteps: Apply at your bank or post office where you hold a savings account.
Choose desired monthly pension slab and auto-debit frequency.
Maintain regular contributions until age 60.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
benefitSummary: Low-cost annual accidental death and full disability insurance cover (₹2 lakh for full cover / ₹1 lakh for partial).
documents: Savings bank account with auto-debit mandate
applySteps: Opt in through your bank branch, net banking, or mobile banking.
Authorize annual auto-debit.
Keep account funded for annual renewal.

rules.reason: Adult member eligible for accident cover

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
benefitSummary: Renewable one-year life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for eligible account holders.
applySteps: Enroll at your bank or via banking app with nominee details.
Enable annual auto-debit.
Renew annually as per policy cycle.

rules.reason: Member is within eligible age band

name: Soil Health Card & Nutrient Advisory
benefitSummary: Soil testing and crop-wise fertilizer/nutrient recommendations to improve yield and soil fertility.
applySteps: Get soil sample collected via agriculture extension officer or soil testing lab.
Download or collect your Soil Health Card.
Apply recommended soil nutrients per crop cycle.
